tencentcloud_region.description: Tencent Cloud region, for example ap-guangzhou. Must contain the selected image and VPC.

tencentcloud_secret_id.description: CAM SecretId used only by the Terraform provider. Grant scoped CVM lifecycle, image/network describe, tagging and encrypted system disk permissions; never delivered to the guest.

tencentcloud_secret_key.description: CAM SecretKey paired with tencentcloud_secret_id. Stored as a sensitive publisher binding, never placed in user-data or tags.

tencentcloud_availability_zone.description: CVM availability zone, for example ap-guangzhou-6. Must match the subnet and support the selected instance type and encrypted CLOUD_SSD system disks.

tencentcloud_image_id.description: Publisher-reviewed Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS x86_64 image ID with cloud-init and systemd. Pin an image available in the bound region; this ID is not a disk-content digest. ARM and Windows images are unsupported.

tencentcloud_vpc_id.description: Existing VPC; shared infrastructure is never created or destroyed by this template.

tencentcloud_subnet_id.description: Existing subnet in the selected VPC and availability zone. With default zero public bandwidth it must provide NAT egress to GitHub releases, Actions endpoints and Ubuntu package repositories.

tencentcloud_security_group_ids.description: Existing security groups in priority order. Allow required outbound traffic; no inbound access is needed. The template creates no security group or rule.

tencentcloud_instance_type.description: x86_64 CVM instance type, default S5.MEDIUM4. Availability and quota must be verified in the target zone.

tencentcloud_system_disk_size.description: Encrypted CLOUD_SSD system disk size in GiB, default 50; must accommodate the image. Released with the instance. Account KMS activation/authorization may be required.

tencentcloud_internet_max_bandwidth_out.description: Public outbound bandwidth in Mbps, default 0 (no public IP; requires NAT). Positive values allocate an instance public IP with traffic-based billing; no EIP is created.

tencentcloud_cloud_init_cmd.description: Optional trusted publisher Bash preparation body, run as root before runner installation without a JIT environment or template expansion. Never include credentials. Failure stops bootstrap. The complete encoded user-data must fit CVM's 16 KiB limit.
